verdict.rationale: Galileo ships an official Python SDK (galileo-python on GitHub) with decorators for logging spans, plus documented usage across cookbooks (LangChain, LangGraph, weather app, Stripe agent) showing SDK-based tracing, evaluation, and agentic metrics integration. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of SDK reliability/versioning and no explicit mention of SDKs in other languages beyond Python.
